blurb: The religion of the Sumerian city-states: a pantheon of city gods, temple-centered worship, and the concept of the me — divine ordinances ordering the world.

events.description: One of the oldest known works of wisdom literature: proverbial instructions from King Shuruppak to his son Ziusudra, the Sumerian flood hero. Copied in scribal schools for over a millennium.
events.title: Instructions of Shuruppak

events.description: 42 hymns addressed to the temples of Sumer, attributed to Enheduanna — daughter of Sargon of Akkad and high priestess of Nanna at Ur — the earliest named author in world literature.
events.title: Temple Hymns of Enheduanna

name: Sumerian religion
